title: My version of “Because I got high” By Richard Cowan

content_html_sanitized:
Posted October 11, 2001

I should explain that I had a very sheltered youth. Although I have been a libertarian since I was in college, I really did not have a clue about what was really going on. Some of what I learned – Because I got high -- came directly from the experience of altered consciousness, but much more came from my involvement in the marijuana reform movement, which almost certainly would not have happened, if I had not gotten high.

Much more came from the fellowship with others… Because I got high.

I certainly do not think that everyone has to get high to learn what I have learned. I may just be a slow learner.

In any case, this is my personal list, reflecting my own life and experiences, but you will have your own.

Because I got high…. By Richard Cowan

Because I got high…. I found the doors of perception and saw beyond the material, and I learned to look for that of God in everyone.

Because I got high…. I came to love the peace of cannabis, and avoid the aggression of alcohol.

Because I got high…. I found out how very privileged that I really was, being able to take justice for granted, when it is not granted to so many others.

Because I got high…. I found that lies have consequences for the liars as well as their victims, so there is a very good reason that we are commanded not to be false witnesses against our neighbors.

Because I got high…. I found out that my protectors were often predators on others.

Because I got high…. I learned that truth may be an option for the powerful, but it is a necessity for the powerless. It may be all that they have.

Because I got high…. I found out that many who are supposed to be healers are really poisoners.

Because I got high…. I learned to look to nature to find my own nature.

Because I got high…. I have had the honor to know many who stand up for freedom, and they are my heroes.

Because I got high…. I found that many who say that they value our freedom, value it so much that they want to take it from us.

Because I got high…. I found out that many who want to be seen as leaders are really following those who do not want to be seen at all.

Because I got high…. I learned that most slaves are slaves because they are waiting for someone else to free them.

Because I got high…. I learned that when children are lied to, what they learn is distrust.

Because I got high…. I have learned healing from the sick, freedom from the imprisoned and resistance from the powerful.

Because I got high…. I have learned that as much as I love peace, there are those who will not leave us in peace.

Because I got high…. I can easily forgive my own enemies, but how can I offer forgiveness so cheaply to those who attack my friends?

Because I got high…. I have learned that we must seek meaning in our lives, but that there are those who would destroy all meaning, so that they can destroy all freedom.

Because I got high…. I have found that life without a purpose is not life at all.

Because I got high…. My purpose is to bring to others the freedom that God has given me. And so long as I can, that is what I will do, Because I got high….
